We love to see you prestige players compete for the highest scores and find better and better strategies. We want to keep this a fair and fun competition, so it is important that everyone plays on equal terms.

Please understand that your runs might be flagged as inadmissible or might get deleted, if it seems like you are using cheat tools or exploits.
We define exploits as anything that provides you a tangible benefit in your prestige run that is not intended through normal gameplay means. This includes things like savegame editing or viewing, excessive reloading, using mods that are not whitelisted or intentional and repeated use of bugs.
You might get permanently barred from competing on the usual leaderboards, if your run appears to have made significant use of cheats or exploits.

If you are unsure about whether something is considered illegal, please ask on our Discord or via e-mail at dome@bippinbits.com. You can always appeal to us, if you got flagged wrongly.

Have fun!
